extracted_details.description_text: The supplied INF identifies Surface Integration Driver version 120.8.4.0, dated 05/06/2026, for the System class and hardware ID ACPI\MSHW0530. INFDescriptionData was semantically analyzed: it installs SurfaceIntegrationDriver.sys and Windows 10/Windows 11 power-policy provisioning packages, enables the KIP-supported platform flag, configures a 14-point display backlight power curve, changes power-estimation and long-press screen-refresh settings, and raises BitLocker encryption/decryption request limits. The exact version is available in the supplied INF, but no official exact-version release notes or verified vendor download page could be retrieved in this session; therefore, the functional details here are based on the INF only, not on previous, latest, or family-version release notes. The supplied Intel links identify Intel Management Engine/chipset resources and do not establish that they document this Surface Integration Driver package.
key_components: SurfaceIntegrationDriver.sys, installed as a demand-start kernel driver for ACPI\MSHW0530.
Surface.Power.Policy.Defaults.ppkg, Surface.Power.Policy.WIN10.Defaults.ppkg, and Surface.Power.Policy.WIN11-0.Defaults.ppkg, registered as policy package files for the device.
SurfaceService registry capability PlatformKipSupported, set to 1; the INF comment says this enables KIP power-saving features.
Display backlight power-estimation curve with 14 brightness/power points, plus display panel power-estimation factor settings.
Windows power registry settings controlling the user battery-discharge estimator and screen refresh on a long power-button press.
BitLocker fvevol registry settings that set maximum encryption, decryption, and crypto requests per I/O to 0x40.
key_functionalities: Enables the platform's KIP-supported flag, which the INF describes as enabling KIP power-saving features.
Installs default and OS-specific Windows 10/Windows 11 power policy packages.
Provides a 14-point brightness-to-backlight-power curve for Windows display energy estimation.
Hides the estimated remaining battery discharge time by setting UserBatteryDischargeEstimator to 0xFFFFFFFF.
Enables screen refresh when the power button is held down, through EnableScreenRefreshOnPowerButtonLongPress=1.
Raises BitLocker encryption, decryption, and per-I/O crypto request limits to 0x40; the INF comment states the encryption request limit is intended to improve SSD performance under BitLocker.

impact_details: May affect platform power-saving behavior where KIP uses the SurfaceService PlatformKipSupported flag; the INF explicitly associates that setting with KIP power saving.
May affect Windows energy estimates for display backlight use because the INF installs a 14-point brightness-to-power curve and sets display panel estimation factors.
Changes battery UX by hiding the estimated time remaining until battery discharge.
Enables a screen refresh behavior for a long power-button press.
May affect SSD performance under BitLocker by increasing encryption/decryption and crypto request limits; the INF specifically describes the encryption limit as intended to improve SSD performance.
